hello.since: last received segment id, or null for a fresh client
hello.note: Sent on every connect. The server replays everything after `since`.

reconnection: Detect the disconnect and show it. DO NOT clear the transcript.
Send hello with the last segment id received.
Ignore any segment id already held — this makes the replay idempotent.

session.started.note: Capture began. Carries a config snapshot.

session.capture_ended.note: The microphone or monitor has been released. Emitted immediately on stop, before the video is finalised, remuxed, or transcribed — all of which can take tens of seconds. `finalising` is true when work remains.

session.stopped.note: Capture ended and everything that follows it is done. Carries final statistics.

transcript.committed.note: Append permanently. Never modify an existing entry. Order by id, not arrival.

transcript.hypothesis.note: Replace the tentative tail wholly. NOT a list entry — treating it as one duplicates text on screen. An empty text means clear the tail.

transcript.polished.note: A finished minute rewritten for reading. Append the block and hide the raw segments listed in source_ids — do not delete them. A client that ignores this event keeps showing raw segments, which is the correct fallback.

status.note: Health telemetry. rtf below 1.0 must show as a problem.

asr.progress.note: Model load progress, with a named state.

summary.added.note: A new entry in the running outline.

chat.delta.note: One fragment of a streaming answer.

chat.done.note: The answer is complete. Carries usage and citations.

error.note: severity is info | warning | critical. Never a modal.
